import json, random, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/project'); sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/fuzz')
import solver, ref, gen
from pathlib import Path
lib = solver.load_library(Path('/workspace/project'), Path('/tmp')); solver.bind(lib)
t = int(sys.argv[1]); seed0 = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 1
rng = random.Random(seed0 + t)
case = gen.gen_case(rng)
case['trace'] = 32
want = ref.solve_case(case); got = solver.replay(case, lib)
print(json.dumps(case))
print('--- got vs want frames')
g = got['trace']; w = want['trace']
for i in range(max(len(g), len(w))):
    a = g[i]['hex'] if i < len(g) else '-'
    b = w[i]['hex'] if i < len(w) else '-'
    mark = '  ' if (i < len(g) and i < len(w) and g[i] == w[i]) else '**'
    print('%s %2d got  %s' % (mark, i, a))
    if mark == '**': print('   %2d want %s' % (i, b))
print('state got ', got['state'])
print('state want', want['state'])
PYEOF
